🤩 Fireside Chat with Peter Norvig at Digital Bridge 2025!

🌟 On September 30 at 14:00 at Astana Hub (Event Hall, Block C 4.6), there will be a unique session with one of the world’s leading AI experts — Peter Norvig, Director of Research at Google.

Who is Peter Norvig?
🔹 Co-author of the iconic textbook Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach
🔹 Co-creator of an online AI course with over 160,000 students
🔹 Former leader of Google’s core search algorithm development
🔹 Member of leading global academies and associations (AAAI, ACM, and more)

🎙 In an open dialogue, Peter will share:
 • Insights on the future of AI and Google’s role in shaping it
 • His personal journey in science, education, and working with startups
 • How AI is transforming the global ecosystem

⚡️ Moderator: Ramesh Chander, Head of Google for Startups & Developers (MENAT Region).

📍 Astana, Mangilik Yel Ave. 55/8, Astana Hub, Event Hall
📅 September 30, 14:00

❕ Don’t miss the chance to hear an AI expert live. Registration link in bio.
